newsitem.title: USA: IndeNet agrees to merge with Petry Media.
newsitem.headline: IndeNet agrees to merge with Petry Media.

text.p: IndeNet Inc said Wednesday it has signed a non-binding letter of intent for a proposed business combination with Petry Media Corp.

IndeNet said terms call for it to issue its common stock in exchange for 100 percent of Petry Media's capital stock, so that Petry Media shareholders will own 59 percent of IndeNet and existing IndeNet shareholders will own 41 percent of IndeNet.

The merger requires IndeNet shareholder approval and approval by both companies' boards. A mutually agreed upon lock-up provision will apply to common shares issued to Petry Media shareholders, the company said.

IndeNet, an equipment and software supplier to the television and cable industry, said its pro forma revenues for the year ended March 31 were about $50 million. It said Petry Media's pro forma revenues for 1995 were more than $100 million.
